plugins.name: create-master-plan
plugins.description: Step 1 of a plan-first multi-agent workflow: pull a ticket from GitHub by default (Jira, Linear and free-form text are adapter profiles), follow its linked items, cited documents and attachments, scan the repo's docs/ exhaustively, detect the tech stack, interview you over a coverage matrix, and write issue.specs plus master-plan.md.

plugins.name: decompose-plan
plugins.description: Step 2 of a plan-first multi-agent workflow, packaged verbatim from its author's own files: turn a master plan into atomic phases grouped into parallel rounds, file-conflict checked and skill-matched, emitting phases/, tasks.md, execute-plan.md and handoff.md for multi-agent execution.

plugins.name: plan-review
plugins.description: Steps 4-5 of a plan-first multi-agent workflow, packaged from its author's own files: generate a self-contained review prompt for a fresh external reviewer — either of the plan before it is built, or of the real changeset against the plan afterwards — and optionally run it through the Codex CLI.
